title: The Results of Good Deeds
text: The next day.
“Hmm…”

When my father-in-law and I used magic to hide and check out the nearby village, it seemed the castle soldiers had put up a wanted poster with our descriptions—specifically naming my father-in-law and me. At first, my father-in-law looked worried and suggested we hide in the bushes, but with my Liberation-class concealment magic combined with my Skills, there’s no way we could be found. So, we’re hiding perfectly well without any issues.
“Naofumi Iwatani, the Demon of the Shield, has massacred the Royal Guard and is on the run after kidnapping the Second Princess. Dead or alive. The reward is—”
Although the circumstances differ, the details of the wanted notice haven’t changed. However, since there’s no conclusive evidence, it’s still just based on testimony.
“Did the Demon of the Shield really kidnap the princess?”
“That’s right. The Second Princess went missing after saying she was going to meet the Demon of the Shield. That’s irrefutable proof.”

But the villagers don’t seem to be buying it. Well, of course not. Without conclusive testimony and with her whereabouts unknown, it’s hard to conclusively prove the crime. Besides, I’ve already taken care of the knights’ bodies. I turned them into charcoal. Not even the knights’ corpses can serve as evidence.
“The Second Princess and the knights who set out for the Demon of the Shield have both gone missing.”
“Then why are people saying they were massacred? They’re missing, aren’t they?”
“Are you defying the kingdom’s orders?!”
The soldier’s flying off the handle at the villager’s question. Father let out a sigh of exasperation.
“……A knight who fought valiantly managed to escape with his life and gave testimony!”
That sounds like nothing more than a last-minute excuse. He’s saying something different from what he said a moment ago. But ‘valiantly’? It’s so ridiculous I can’t help but laugh.

They launched a surprise attack out of nowhere, and the rest of them just fled like scared rabbits. Well, they couldn’t escape beyond the range of my Skills, though. Either way, it’s clear to everyone that the plan is proceeding exactly as originally intended.
“What a bastard! The Shield Demon’s deeds—I’ll never forgive him! If the Shield Demon comes, let’s all kill him!”

Among the villagers tilting their heads in confusion, there’s one who’s particularly enraged. Gradually, led by that one person, the villagers are starting to get into the mood to kill my Father. These guys… are so simple-minded. If they’re coming, let them come. Let’s turn the tables on them.
“So? Where has the Shield Demon been all this time, and what has he been up to?”
“He’s been wreaking havoc all over the country! He’s been repeatedly robbing adventurers and villagers!”
“There are even Demi-Humans working with the Shield Demon! Here’s the wanted poster.”
As soon as a wanted poster resembling Keel was posted, the villagers’ excitement began to drop instantly.
“Hey… this guy is…”
Furthermore, drawings depicting the Filolial-sama—Sakura-chan, Yuki-chan, Kou, Luna-chan, and others—began to be posted as well.
“He’s having a carriage pulled by an evil demon in the form of an unfamiliar bird. Anyone who sees him should contact the kingdom immediately.”
As soon as the soldier announced this, the murmurings grew even louder. What on earth is this reaction?

“That’s right. The Shield Demon who has appeared this time is the one scattering crops imbued with the power of brainwashing—masquerading as goodwill—across the entire kingdom and forcing people to buy his drugs. Citizens! Wake up!”
The villagers fell silent for a moment at the soldier’s testimony. Then Sakura—who had been so worked up just moments ago—shouted out loudly.
“I-I didn’t realize that! The Holy One of the Divine Bird was the Shield Demon all along! That bastard—pretending to be a good person, but he’s nothing but a scoundrel!”
Her loud voice echoed across the square, and after a brief pause, the others began to speak as well.
“How awful!”
“Oh… To think that charity we received when we thought we wouldn’t even have food for tomorrow was actually malicious!”
“Oh, God…”

Before long, the villagers were voicing their agreement in unison, gradually closing in around the soldier and Sakura. Father looked deeply disappointed. It seemed there was no longer any need for further confirmation. Just as I thought that—
“What did you expect me to say?!”
“Don’t mess with us! The Holy One of the Divine Bird treated us for free and provided food at a bargain price!”
“If it weren’t for the Holy One of the Divine Bird, this child would have starved to death by now!”
The villagers, clearly enraged, are closing in on the soldier and Sakura. The soldier and Sakura look bewildered by this unexpected reaction.
“That’s the devil’s scheme! The devil is spreading both famine and disease! People, don’t be fooled!”
“Shut up! Don’t you dare speak ill of the Saint!”
“You ungrateful wretches! If we hadn’t gotten food from the Saint of the Divine Bird, we’d all be dead! Lives we never really had anyway! I believe in the Shield Hero!”
“This is a national conspiracy! You’re trying to incite a riot!”
Saying things like this, they began to beat up Sakura. The villagers’ punches and kicks rained down on her.
“Ugh! Guh!”
Seeing this, the soldiers raised their voices once more, as if to counter the villagers’ outcry.
“Are you defying the will of the nation? The Shield Demon kidnapped the Second Princess!”
“That’s just another conspiracy by the government and the Three Heroes Church to frame the Shield Hero!”
“You insolent fools! You’re traitors to the nation! The government won’t forgive you!”
“Shut up! We’re here to protect the Shield Hero! They’re imposing heavy taxes on us when everyone’s struggling!”
“The Holy One of the Divine Bird is the Shield Hero, and he concealed his true identity to bring us salvation!”

A clash broke out between the soldiers and the villagers. Some of the villagers, skilled in martial arts, were defeating the soldiers and hanging them up. We stood there, staring in stunned silence at the scene of this mob lynching.

Eventually, the symbol of the Three Heroes Church in the village church was destroyed, and the villagers trampled it underfoot. Seizing the opportunity, the villagers then seemed to storm the nobleman’s mansion, which they had been managing.
“Um… I’m really happy you believe me, but… this isn’t exactly okay, is it…?”
My father watched the scene, breaking out in a cold sweat.
“For now, let’s head back.”
“I suppose so.”
We left the village and made our way back to the carriage.

Before long—in less than a few hours—people near the town began whispering that a revolution was sweeping across the entire Melromarc kingdom. The news that the Saint of the Divine Bird was the Shield Hero spread throughout the kingdom, sending shockwaves across the entire realm. It’s safe to say this was an outcome the Three Heroes Church never could have anticipated.

Everyone seemed to recognize that the Shield Hero was delivering food throughout the country out of goodwill, and their distrust of the government appeared to be growing. The seeds in question were the fruits of a plant—whose origin had been confirmed—that was originally cultivated in the Lazy Pig’s territory; they carried a moral lesson—that if you slack off, they wither—and because of this, people placed their trust in the Saint of the Divine Bird’s saintly demeanor.

Moreover, few people failed to notice him selling medicine at bargain prices and treating the sick. Even if he was disguising his appearance, his actions overlapped with the legend of the reincarnation of the Divine Bird Saint, and despite being reviled as the “Demon of the Shield,” his great deeds in saving people remained untarnished.
“Guys, how did it go?”

“Maybe our efforts paid off—it seems everyone’s caught on to the Three Heroes Church’s plot. Even though we’re wanted, they don’t seem too scared… I guess? At worst, it might be best to wait somewhere for the Queen to return.”
“Huh… You know, Melty-chan…”
My fiancée looks a bit down and is leaning against Sakura-chan.
“It’ll be okay. I’m sure everything will work out. I’ll protect you, so don’t worry.”
“I know, but…”
“You’re worried about the country, aren’t you, Melty-chan? Well… I think this conspiracy will blow over soon. After all, we have Motoyasu-kun here, who knows what the future holds.”
“That’s right. The Three Heroes Church is behind this whole incident; Trash and Crimson Swine are completely on the sidelines.”
For some reason, my finacée averted her gaze from me. Hmm, could she have realized that my finacée and I are destined rivals? Soon after, she pointed at me and said to my future Father,
“Is this guy okay in the head?”
If your Good Deeds score reaches a certain threshold, the story branches into the Revolution route.
Note that if your Good Deeds score is too high, it will be difficult to recruit a certain brother and sister as allies.
